jyutping: ting1 dak1 dou2 ge3 faan6 wai4

english.note: Use this noun phrase for the area within which someone can hear, especially in 喺聽得到嘅範圍內.

examples.english: Once you walk out of our hearing range, you won't hear us.
examples.traditional: 你行出我哋聽得到嘅範圍，就聽唔到喇。
